newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TENNIS-EDBERG BOWS OUT IN FIRST ROUND.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-EDBERG BOWS OUT IN FIRST ROUND.

text.p: Stefan Edberg ended his international singles career on Tuesday, losing his first-round match in the Stockholm Open to fellow Swede Nicklas Kulti.
In an 80-minute contest, Kulti defeated 30-year-old former world number one Edberg 7-6 6-3.
In an emotional farewell in front of his home crowd, Edberg thanked his fans for their support during his 14-year career.
Edberg won six Grand Slam titles and was ranked world number one in 1990 and 1991.
At the end of 1995 he announced his plans to retire from competitive tennis to spend more time with his family.
